title: Scandinavian Defense: Gubinsky-Melts Defense
line: The queen steps back to the center, and a side pawn keeps White's knight away from her.

steps.text: In the Scandinavian, Black took back with the queen and White's knight hit her.
Step the queen back to d6. She stays in the center and watches the dark squares.

also.d5a5: That is the main line, and just as sound. This lesson goes on with the queen on d6.
also.d5d8: That is also played. This lesson goes on with the queen on d6.

steps.text: Push the pawn on a7 one square. It keeps White's knight off b5, where it would hit your queen.

also.g7g6: That also works. This lesson keeps the knight off b5 first.
also.c7c6: That also keeps the knight off b5. This lesson goes on with the other pawn.

steps.text: Bring the bishop out to pin the knight to White's queen.
Bring the other knight out. With your queen it hits the pawn on d4.
steps.after: The pawn on d4 is attacked twice, and the knight on f3 that guards it is pinned.

summary: In the Gubinsky-Melts the queen stays in the center, a side pawn keeps the knight away, and the pieces hit the center.
